about: Drag and drop between Astro and another application (docs/adr/0035-drag-and-drop.mdx, decision 14): Astro's `oxyos` platform speaks protocol 10, and sample/DragProbe.tsx, a second application beside it (`companion`, Stash's stand-in), drags through the platform's drag and takes drops in its drop target. A file of the run's home dragged from the probe onto the page's <input type="file"> reaches it: the page sees a drag of files before the drop (the types alone, `application/x-oxyos-files`), and at the drop the input holds informe.txt, its content read (the zone green). A link dragged out of Astro drops in the probe as its URL; an image dragged out drops as a file, written by Astro to a temporary folder (a file manager takes it as a file). Run with the engine as `--client`; the page (pages/astro-dnd.html) is Astro's tab, 190 px right of the window's edge and 47 px down, the window moved to the output's top left (20, 60) on a 1920x1080 output.

steps.name: Astro to the output's top left, the probe beside it
a file of the home dragged from the probe onto the page's file input: the input holds it, its content read
a link dragged out of Astro onto the probe's drop target: it drops as its URL
an image dragged out of Astro onto the probe's drop target: it drops as a file Astro wrote
